question: Which queen of the worlds protects the navel with her lolling-tongued form?
premises: Bhuvaneśvarī is invoked with the epithet lolling-tongued.
Protection is sought at the navel.
inference: The lolling-tongued Bhuvaneśvarī continually protects the navel.
plain_english: May the lolling-tongued Bhuvaneśvarī always protect me at the navel.
